method: Static conservative source traversal only; no go list, compiler, test, formatting, executable discovery or Go subprocess. Include all production Go files regardless of tags/GOOS in first-party imported dirs, and all root CLI test files. Import regex and initializer hits are review indexes, not a Go parser proof. Dependency test files are excluded because imported dependencies do not execute tests.
